newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: DUTCH HOLEC TO START JOINT VENTURE IN CHINA.
newsitem.headline: DUTCH HOLEC TO START JOINT VENTURE IN CHINA.

text.p: Dutch engineering group Holec Holland said on Wednesday its unit Holec Middenspanning BV had signed an agreement with China's Zhenjiang Electrical to start a joint venture in China for the production of medium voltage switch-gear systems.
Holec declined to give financial details of the required investment for the new plant.
Holec said the new plant in Yangzhong, in the East of China, was expected to be ready within 10 months.
"The production is for the local market," said Ton de Haan of Holec Holland.
Holec said in a press release there were about 300 million people living in the region near Yangzhong.
